rows.Bloom: Pink, orange-pink shading, ages to light pink . Mild, fruity, sweet fragrance. Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
